name: trapz_logical
expr: u = trapz(Y); nx = trapz(X, Y); lx = trapz(LX, DY); cc = trapz(M); rr = trapz(M, 2); sc = trapz(true); em = trapz(logical([]));
comment: trapz on logical input. MATLAB promotes a logical X and/or Y to double (class NOT preserved — integration returns double). Covers unit-spacing vector, non-uniform X, logical-X+double-Y, 2-D column + dim2, scalar (->0) and empty (->0). char still errors on both engines. bugs/builtin/trapz-logical.md.
